items.why: OTT is video delivered over the internet directly, bypassing cable or broadcast providers.
OOH is advertising seen outside the house, such as billboards and transit.

items.q: What does SSAI stand for in video advertising?
items.why: With SSAI the ad is stitched into the video stream on the server, so it plays like the content.

items.q: What does CLS measure on a web page?
items.why: CLS tells you how much the page jumps around while loading, which ads can make worse.

items.q: What does LCP stand for in page performance?
items.why: LCP is the time until the main content of a page appears.

items.q: What does SDK stand for in an app publisher setting?
items.why: Apps use an ad SDK, a code package from an ad platform, to request and show ads.

items.q: What does ACR stand for in CTV measurement?
items.why: ACR identifies what is playing on a smart TV, and it is used to measure viewing and match ad exposure.

items.q: What does FAST stand for in streaming?
items.why: FAST channels are free to watch and paid for by ads, like linear TV delivered over the internet.
